notes.residency_days_threshold: A resident individual is a person who has a permanent home in Uganda; or is present in Uganda: for a period of 183 days or more in any twelve (12) months period that commences or ends during the year of income; or during the year of income and in each of the two preceding years of income, for periods averaging 122 days in each such year of income; or is an employee or official of the government of Uganda posted abroad during the year of income.
notes.bik_housing_employment_income_rate: Accommodation/housing: the lesser of: a) the market rent of the accommodation or housing reduced by any payment made by the employee for the benefit; or b) 15% of the employment income, including the amount referred to in paragraph (a), paid by the employer to the employee for the year of income. Benefits in kind are added to employment income and are subject to PAYE.
notes.bik_motor_vehicle_inclusion_rate: Motor vehicle: (20% x A x B/C) - D where A is the market value of the motor vehicle at the time when it was first provided for the private use of the employee, depreciated on a reducing balance basis at a rate of 35% per annum for the subsequent years; B is the number of days in the year of income in which the motor vehicle was used or available for use for private purposes; C is the number of days in the year of income; D is any payment made by the employee for the benefit.
notes.withholding_non_resident_service_contrac: A Ugandan-sourced service contract does not include an employment contract (Withholding-Tax-FY-2024-25-1.pdf).
notes.paye_bands_resident: The top band is the 30% band plus the additional 10% charge on chargeable income above UGX 10,000,000 per month, expressed here as a single 40% marginal rate.
notes.customs_duty_common: Indicative EAC CET band for finished consumer goods. The binding rate is the tariff line for the specific HS code.
